test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FIGHT’ is written as ‘45’ and ‘VENT’ is written as ‘57’.How will ‘TREND’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:** Sum of positional values of all the letters - Number of letters in the word**

‘FIGHT’ is written as ‘45’ 

⇒ F(6) + I(9) + G(7) + H(8) + T(20) = 50 - 5 = **45**

And,

‘VENT’ is written as ‘57’

⇒ V(22) + E(5) + N(14) T(20) = 61 - 4 **= 57**

Similarly,

‘TREND’ will be written as:

⇒ T(20) + R(18) + E(5) + N(14) + D(4) = 61 - 5 = **56**

Hence,** 'option 3' **is the correct answer.
